description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is looking for a DevOps focused Software Engineer to support the enterprise language services team. A successful candidate would have a deep understanding of Kubernetes, containerization and cloud-native technologies. Will be responsible for the implementation of the project’s Kubernetes-based infrastructure and applications.

 Required Skills:

 
 Experience with Kubernetes container orchestration, including deployment, scaling and management

 Knowledge of Helm charts for simplifying application deployment of Kubernetes

 Proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management

 Hands-on experience with AWS services and architecture

 Strong scripting skills using Bash, with the ability to automate tasks and processes

 
 Desired Skills:

 
 Experience with ArgoCD for automating deployment pipelines

 Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Prometheus/Grafana

 Familiarity with KEDA for scalable Kubernetes workloads

 Elasticsearch expertise for search, logging, or analytics use cases

 PostgreSQL database administration skills

 Node.js and TypeScript development experience

 Angular framework knowledge

 
 Qualifications:

 
 An active security clearance with polygraph.

  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
